tasks.question: Do the synthetic logistic well descriptors match hand arithmetic after frozen blank subtraction?
acceptance_criteria: A1 maximum log slope = log(2.5)/2, lag = -35/27, observed maximum = 0.8, AUC = 2, doubling = 2*log(2)/log(2.5).
Capacity mean = 0.7 and SE = 0.1; AUC mean = 1.75 and SE = 0.25 over two reliable technical wells and one biological unit.
Saturated A3 and noisy non-converged A4 remain visible and excluded. No claim of logistic fitted rate recovery.

tasks.question: Does each synthetic defect refuse with its stated finding?
acceptance_criteria: All 19 seeded cases refuse through the public function and JSON CLI.
CLI argument errors emit finding on stderr with exit 2; help is stdout exit 0.
Unsafe paths, replaced ancestors, resource limits and strict JSON fail without hanging or writing.
